digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर एशिया-प्रशांत की अगुवाई है, दिल्ली में किशोरी से सामूहिक दुष्कर्म: कालकाजी मंदिर के पास हुई हैवानियत, दर्शन करने आई थी पीड़िता मुख्य खबर है। साथ ही दुनिया से भी घटनाक्रम सामने आया है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Venezuela después del pacto petrolero con EE. UU.
articles.summary: La administración Trump ha anunciado un acuerdo con Caracas que, según dice, otorga a EE. UU. una participación importante en la industria petrolera venezolana. En esta sesión de preguntas y respuestas, los expertos de Crisis Group Phil Gunson y Delaney Simon analizan las repercusiones de dicho acuerdo. Venezuela después del pacto petrolero con EE.

articles.title: Testing the waters? Businesses weigh China’s new trade shortcut to Southeast Asia
articles.summary: The Pinglu Canal provides China’s landlocked southwest region with a much shorter water route to the South China Sea - and Southeast Asia. But turning early business interest into sustained demand will be the bigger test, say analysts. Testing the waters? Businesses weigh China’s new trade shortcut to Southeast Asia.

articles.title: Relentless wildfires push Sumatra’s firefighters to their limits
articles.summary: Wildfires in Indonesia have caused transboundary haze and disrupted livelihoods in Sumatra. In the second of a series, CNA meets the firefighters enduring choking smoke, sleepless nights and scarce water - and finds out what keeps them going. Relentless wildfires push Sumatra’s firefighters to their limits.

articles.title: U.S. television networks halt Trump coverage in revolt over White House ban
articles.summary: The move means there will be no television coverage of Mr. Trump's trip on Monday, September 21, to the United Nations General Assembly in New York, where he was due to meet a series of foreign leaders. articles.title: Colombia declares public calamity as wildfire threatens popular tourist area
articles.summary: Wildfire forces evacuations and burns through mountains surrounding Villa de Leyva in the north-east Colombian authorities declared a public calamity as a wildfire burned through mountains surrounding one of the country’s best-known colonial towns in the north-east, scorching large swaths of vegetation and forcing evacuations. Nearly 20 active fires are burning across the South American country. Dr Colombia declares public calamity as wildfire threatens popular tourist area.

articles.title: US strikes on alleged drug boats may constitute ‘crimes against humanity’, UN expert says
articles.summary: Dozens of US attacks on boats in the Pacific and Caribbean have killed more than 230 people since September 2025A special rapporteur for the UN human rights council has concluded that there are “reasonable grounds to believe” that the United States attacks on boats allegedly carrying drugs in the Pacific and Caribbean “constituted crimes against humanity”. US strikes on alleged drug boats may constitute ‘crimes against humanity’, UN expert says.

articles.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico to sue Trump administration over White House access
articles.summary: "This morning, we notified the government that we are filing a lawsuit today to protect our First Amendment rights and defend the principle that the government does not decide what the press reports or publishes," says the statement CNN, MS NOW, Politico to sue Trump administration over White House access.

articles.title: Russia's ruling pro-Putin party wins wartime election with over 57% of vote, near-complete results
articles.summary: United Russia won 57. United ‌Russia party won 57.83% of the vote, the Central Election ‌Commission said, up ​from 49.8% which it won ⁠in 2021, the last time an ‌election for the State Duma, the lower house of parliament, was held. articles.title: Drones And Desolation: The Long Road To Donetsk's Bilozerske
articles.summary: RFE/RL’s Ukrainian Service correspondent Maryan Kushnir walked some 20 kilometers to reach the embattled city of Bilozerske, in Ukraine’s Donetsk region, which soldiers say has been effectively destroyed by Russian strikes over the past year. Drones And Desolation: The Long Road To Donetsk's Bilozerske.

articles.title: UN experts detail Ukraine war’s toll and Russia’s reach beyond its borders
articles.summary: UN Human Rights Council-appointed experts on Monday laid out a grim picture of the human cost of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, with a spotlight on civilians facing a third wartime winter as well as the intimidation of Russians who have fled abroad. UN experts detail Ukraine war’s toll and Russia’s reach beyond its borders.

articles.title: Why climate action now comes down to speed, finance and cooperation
articles.summary: Temporarily exceeding the 1.5°C global warming goal set in Paris is widely considered inevitable. The challenge now is to keep that overshoot as small and short as possible by cutting emissions faster, unlocking finance and strengthening international cooperation. Why climate action now comes down to speed, finance and cooperation.

articles.title: Irish privacy regulator fines Google €403 million over location data processing
articles.summary: “As ​a result ‌of Google’s failures, individuals could have been unaware that their location was being used to, for ‌example, influence them with ads ​or to infer their interests, and could lose control ⁠over their personal data,” DPC Deputy Commissioner Graham Doyle said Irish privacy regulator fines Google €403 million over location data processing.

articles.title: China’s J-36 may soon fly with lasers the US couldn’t master
articles.summary: Recent revelations from China’s defense industry suggest the long-sought goal of mounting combat lasers onto fighter aircraft may finally be moving from theory to reality. articles.title: ASEAN’s digital payment boom outrunning its scam defenses
articles.summary: Southeast Asia’s rapid economic integration has long been a celebrated success story, and nowhere is this more evident today than in its retail payment systems. Across the region, central banks are linking their national QR code protocols under the ASEAN Regional Payment Connectivity initiative, enabling friction-free, cross-border digital transactions between citizens of Indonesia, Thailand, Mala ASEAN’s digital payment boom outrunning its scam defenses.

articles.title: Banished to alien lands: Trump’s secret deportation deals
articles.summary: After a plane journey in shackles, an Iranian woman found herself in the middle of Africa in a country she did not know existed. She is one of thousands deported from the US on the back of shadowy deals made with dozens of countries. An in-depth investigation reveals the ‘show of force’ costing American taxpayers millionsNo one would tell the shackled detainees onboard the US immigration plane whe.

articles.title: Macron and Carney announce closer France-Canada ties amid Trump tensions
articles.summary: Two leaders meet in French territory off Canada as Ottawa seeks stronger relations with EU while fighting trade war with USThe leaders of France and Canada have pledged closer ties to grapple with rising geopolitical tensions, climate change and the erosion of democratic values, after ⁠they met in a ⁠French territory off Canada’s Atlantic coast. Macron and Carney announce closer France-Canada ties amid Trump tensions.

articles.title: Russia's Parliamentary Vote Ends As Moscow, Kyiv Continue Fighting
articles.summary: There was no let up in fighting between Russia and Ukraine on September 20, as voters in Russia cast ballots on the final day of parliamentary elections from which a political party calling for peace was excluded. Russia's Parliamentary Vote Ends As Moscow, Kyiv Continue Fighting.

articles.title: The right to development: Why equity, not charity, is a human right
articles.summary: Compare two children born in the same year: one in a country with functioning schools, social services, fair elections and a dynamic economy and the other in a nation devastated by poverty, conflict, climate change or corruption. The right to development: Why equity, not charity, is a human right.

articles.title: Afghan Minaret Restoration Marks 'Pragmatic' Taliban Approach To Cultural Heritage, Experts Say
articles.summary: Work is now underway to the restore Afghanistan's Minaret of Jam, which experts say reflects a welcome departure from the icon-smashing rule of the Taliban of the 1990s. The change contrasts with the current Taliban rulers' draconian restrictions on other facets of life in the country. Afghan Minaret Restoration Marks 'Pragmatic' Taliban Approach To Cultural Heritage, Experts Say.

articles.title: Russia's Starlink Rival Faces Problems In Orbit And Threats On The Ground
articles.summary: Russia is racing to build Rassvet, its answer to Starlink, after losing access to the satellite network on the battlefield in Ukraine. But troubled satellites, tight deadlines, and a lack of ground terminals could leave Moscow waiting years. Russia's Starlink Rival Faces Problems In Orbit And Threats On The Ground.

articles.title: Why China is pushing back on US warnings over rapid AI development
articles.summary: Beijing believes slowdown calls aim to lock in US advantage, and is pursuing a different balance between safety and paceAbout two years ago, education entrepreneur Boris But had what he calls a “penny-drop moment” – that, like countless others in China, his company needed to embrace AI before it was made obsolete by it. Why China is pushing back on US warnings over rapid AI development.

articles.summary: US President Donald Trump signed into law legislation aimed at increasing economic pressure on Russia over its war on Ukraine, including by targeting Moscow's energy revenues as well as countries that continue to buy Russian oil and gas. Trump Signs Russia-Iran Sanctions Bill, Putting New Pressure Tools At His Disposal.

articles.title: US-Saudi F-35 fighter deal runs into a China-sized problem
articles.summary: A potential multi-billion-dollar transfer of advanced US stealth fighters to Saudi Arabia has thrust US Middle East policy into a delicate balancing act between regional deterrence, Israeli air superiority and rising geopolitical skepticism. articles.title: Suicide Attack On Police Facility In Northwest Pakistan Leaves Many Dead And Wounded
articles.summary: At least 16 people were reported dead and dozens were injured after an attacker drove a vehicle packed with explosives into a police complex in Pakistan. articles.summary: अमेरिका के तीन मीडिया संस्थानों ने राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप और अमेरिकी प्रशासन के कई टॉप अधिकारियों के खिलाफ मुकदमा दायर किया है. संस्थानों का आरोप है कि अधिकारियों ने इन तीनों संस्थानों के पत्रकारों के व्हाइट हाउस में घुसने पर रोक लगाकर नजरिए के आधार पर भेदभाव किया है, जो अमेरिकी संविधान के पहले संशोधन का सीधा उल्लंघन है. तीनों मीडिया संस्थानों ने सोमवार (21 सितंबर, 2026) को वाशिंगटन डीसी की एक फ।

articles.title: हूतियों के खिलाफ सऊदी ने मांगी मदद, उलझन में ट्रंप, अब क्या करेगा अमेरिका?
articles.summary: ईरान और अमेरिका की जंग में क्षेत्रीय देश जबरन पिस रहे हैं. अगर अमेरिका की मदद करें तो आफत, न करें तो आफत. इधर, हूति विद्रोहियों ने भी सऊदी अरब की टेंशन बढ़ा रखी है. वहीं, अब सऊदी ने सैन्य मदद की अपील अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति से की तो इससे ट्रंप काफी उलझन में नजर आ रहे हैं. हालांकि, एक बार में तबाह करने की धमकी ईरान को ट्रंप कई दफा दे चुके हैं.
